anchors.1: Materially fails the criterion or introduces serious contradictions.
anchors.2: Partially addresses the criterion with important omissions or defects.
anchors.3: Meets the criterion at a competent baseline with minor gaps.
anchors.4: Meets the criterion thoroughly with clear, intentional decisions.
anchors.5: Exceptional execution that is coherent, specific, and robust.

dimensions.title: Brief fidelity
dimensions.question: Does the implementation include the requested content, sections, controls, and constraints without inventing contradictory product behavior?

dimensions.title: Information architecture
dimensions.question: Does the source encode a clear content hierarchy, sensible grouping, and an order appropriate to the primary user task?

dimensions.title: Interaction semantics
dimensions.question: Are interactive elements represented by appropriate controls with understandable labels, states, and non-deceptive behavior?
source_signals: button, link, input, and form semantics

dimensions.title: Accessibility foundations
dimensions.question: Does the implementation provide a sound static accessibility foundation?
disallowed_inference: actual focus visibility against rendered backgrounds

dimensions.title: Responsive intent
dimensions.question: Does the source explicitly account for narrow and wide layouts without relying on fixed desktop-only geometry?
disallowed_inference: absence of clipping in a real viewport

dimensions.title: Implementation integrity
dimensions.question: Is the implementation buildable, internally consistent, offline-safe, and free of obvious placeholder or broken-reference behavior?
source_signals: no placeholder copy where final copy is required

dimensions.title: Visual hierarchy
dimensions.question: Does the rendered interface guide attention in an intentional order?

dimensions.title: Composition and spacing
dimensions.question: Are layout, density, rhythm, alignment, and whitespace coherent across viewports?

dimensions.title: Typography and color
dimensions.question: Do typography and color form a legible, distinctive, and accessible system?

dimensions.title: Visual craft
dimensions.question: Does the interface demonstrate polish, consistency, and context-appropriate detail?

dimensions.title: Distinctiveness
dimensions.question: Does the interface avoid generic template patterns and express a specific visual point of view?
